method: Manually compared actual rendered five-frame motion sheets and cover sheets across FX subcategories; checked edited audit renders against original preset previews at the same time.

decisions.observation: The original lines and sun edge become uniformly soft; this is distinct from the grid and light treatments. Changing sigma alters the rendered frame.
Brightness visibly flashes across the sampled moments while geometry stays intact; unlike static RGB split or noisy glitch. Changing hz alters the rendered sequence.
Highlights bloom around the sun and outlined card while the scene remains colored; unlike the dark vignette. Intensity visibly changes the render.
A regular white grid covers the whole frame with transparent cells, distinct from the centered yellow block. Cell-size edit visibly changes the render.
A semitransparent yellow rectangular area occupies the center-right while the rest stays clear; distinct from the full-frame grid. X-position edit visibly changes the render.
